# Checklist Usage Log

The canonical log is append-only between governed compactions. One review
record is appended per review loop that applied the default checklist, plus
escape records for later-surfaced findings. The record formats, hit-rate
computation, closeout-status derivation, and compaction rule live in
[default-checklist.md](default-checklist.md) § Usage Records and Hit Rate.

Only this canonical file is review-closeout authority. Historical raw records
live in `docs/archive/checklist-usage-log-through-2026-07-18-pr381-4f887feb.md`
and its registered continuation archives, including
`docs/archive/checklist-usage-log-continuation-through-2026-07-19-pr394-1066e927.md`.
They are not parsed for current exact-head closeout.
